problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package 1: mass 50 kg, revenue 287 credits
* Package 2: mass 37 kg, revenue 87 credits
* Package 3: mass 42 kg, revenue 27 credits
* Package 4: mass 20 kg, revenue 237 credits
* Package 5: mass 34 kg, revenue 222 credits
* Package 6: mass 14 kg, revenue 249 credits
* Package 7: mass 14 kg, revenue 210 credits
* Package 8: mass 6 kg, revenue 59 credits
* Package 9: mass 35 kg, revenue 215 credits
* Package 10: mass 8 kg, revenue 269 credits
* Package 11: mass 44 kg, revenue 248 credits
* Package 12: mass 48 kg, revenue 95 credits
* Package 13: mass 3 kg, revenue 113 credits
* Package 14: mass 15 kg, revenue 133 credits
* Package 15: mass 7 kg, revenue 203 credits
* Package 16: mass 27 kg, revenue 45 credits
* Package 17: mass 36 kg, revenue 118 credits
* Package 18: mass 34 kg, revenue 111 credits

The drone has a maximum payload capacity of 331 kg. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
